data_card.source: TrajectoryNet (Tong et al. 2020) eb_velocity_v5.npz, the Moon et al. 2019 embryoid body
data_card.time: sample_labels at unit spacing (1 = six days)

scalers.primary: StandardScaler on all cells (published convention, known leak)
scalers.secondary: StandardScaler on the four observed windows of each fold

torchcfm.rechecked: 2026-09-26, raw files: model/otcfm.yaml, experiment/cfm.yaml, datamodule/time_dist.yaml, src/models/cfm_module.py (leave-out, linspace(0, 1, 101), sigma_min), src/datamodules/distribution_datamodule.py (whiten on all cells, random_split, min_size, drop_last)
torchcfm.source: github.com/atong01/conditional-flow-matching (main): runner/configs/model/otcfm.yaml, runner/configs/experiment/cfm.yaml, runner/configs/datamodule/time_dist.yaml, runner/configs/train.yaml, runner/configs/callbacks/default.yaml, runner/configs/trainer/default.yaml, runner/src/train.py, runner/src/models/cfm_module.py, runner/src/datamodules/distribution_datamodule.py
torchcfm.whiten: StandardScaler on every cell, before the split
torchcfm.ambiguity: time_dist.yaml sets batch_size 128; experiment/cfm.yaml sets datamodule.batch_size 512 and is merged after the datamodule group, so 512 holds for the composition above (with 128: 14 000 iterations). With 512 and drop_last the validation splits hold no batch: by our reading no val/loss is logged, early stopping and checkpoint selection cannot act and the final weights are tested

otcfm.prediction: bracket t-1 -> t+1 integrated from the window t-1 cells to flow time 1/2

w1.fallback: exact assignment on 2000-per-side subsamples, mean of 10 repeats (pre-registration Step 1e), used only without POT

p2a.rule: the flow's per-seed 3-fold mean below every control in every seed; upper paired CI (flow - best control) < 0; upper paired CI (flow - shuffled) < 0
p2a.passes_seed_mean_note: the looser reading (seed means below every control's), descriptive only

p2a_energy_distance.rule: the flow's per-seed 3-fold mean below every control in every seed; upper paired CI (flow - best control) < 0; upper paired CI (flow - shuffled) < 0
p2a_energy_distance.passes_seed_mean_note: the looser reading (seed means below every control's), descriptive only

calibration_gate.rule: W1 of prev (persistence) and next within +-0.05 of TrajectoryNet Table 3 at every fold

p2b.rule: only if gate and check pass: 'below published OT-CFM' iff mean + 1.96 sd/sqrt(5) < 0.790; 'within the published range' iff mean < 0.848; otherwise 'above'; never a significance claim
p2b.reason: descriptive only if the calibration gate and the model check both pass

primary.reading: only within-run comparisons are claimed (a check failed or is not decidable)

p2a.rule: the flow's per-seed 3-fold mean below every control in every seed; upper paired CI (flow - best control) < 0; upper paired CI (flow - shuffled) < 0
p2a.passes_seed_mean_note: the looser reading (seed means below every control's), descriptive only

p2a_energy_distance.rule: the flow's per-seed 3-fold mean below every control in every seed; upper paired CI (flow - best control) < 0; upper paired CI (flow - shuffled) < 0
p2a_energy_distance.passes_seed_mean_note: the looser reading (seed means below every control's), descriptive only

secondary.role: descriptive (the published numbers refer to the primary scaler)

deviations: the OT-CFM equivalent reproduces the runner's hyper-parameters, not its implementation (module docstring: 'Not reproduced')
the OT-CFM iteration count uses the four observed windows' training splits (the runner's loader also holds the held-out window; the counts agree unless that window is the smallest, recorded per fold)
the OT-CFM batch size is 512 (experiment/cfm.yaml merged after datamodule/time_dist.yaml's 128), giving 3000 iterations on the full data; with 128 it would be 14 000 (TORCHCFM['ambiguity'])
readings: P2a decides on the literal per-seed reading (below every control in every seed); the seed-mean reading is reported as passes_seed_mean and decides nothing
a stopped ot.emd2 is retried once at numItermax 1e8; a rule fed by a W1 that still did not converge is 'not decidable' (the exact W1 is the pre-registered metric)
